en.WelcomeHelp: Type "help" or "oxyhelp" to open the list of available commands.
en.WarningResetApp: WARNING: Are you sure you want to delete ALL logs, tasks, and projects? Holidays are not deleted. This operation cannot be undone! Type 'reset' to confirm:
en.ProjectsDesc: Lists all projects in the SQLite database
en.TasksDesc: Lists all tasks and subtasks of a project
en.AddProjectDesc: Creates a new project (name in quotes)
en.AddTaskDesc: Creates a main task in the project
en.AddSubtaskDesc: Creates a subtask for a parent task
en.StartDesc: Starts timer for task_id (no id: starts currently selected task)
en.StopDesc: Stops the active timer (argument: "all" - stops everything)
en.TimeCmdDesc: Calculates work time for a task/subtask/profile in a given period
en.StatusDesc: Displays details of the active running timer
en.CompleteDesc: Toggles completion state of a task
en.LogsDesc: Shows log history from sqlite time_logs
en.ReportDesc: Generates standard and graphical reports for period
en.ErrNoProjects: No projects found in SQLite. Use: addproject "Name"

en.ProjNotExist: Error: Project with ID doesn't exist.
en.ProjNoTasksYet: Project does not have any tasks yet.
en.ErrSpecifyProjQuotes: Error: Specify project name in quotes. Example: addproject "Zouk Project"
en.NoActiveTimer: Info: No active timer is currently running.
en.StateIdle: State: Idle. No active tracker running.
en.NoLogsFound: SQLite database: No logged time sessions found.
en.ErrInvalidDateFormat: Error: Invalid date format. Must be YYYY-MM-DD.
en.NoHolidays: SQLite database: holidays and leaves table is empty.
en.NoLogsPeriod: Info: No logging entries found for period
en.CommandInputPlaceholder: Enter command, e.g. help, projects, start 1, stop...
en.SwitchDesc: Atomically stops active timer and starts tracking specified task (id or name)
en.ErrUnknownCmdHelp: Unknown command: "{command}". Type 'help' to see available commands or 'switch' to change active task.
en.ErrNoTaskSelectedHelp: No task selected. Select a task in the interface or specify Task ID (e.g. 'start 101').
en.ErrTaskAlreadyCompleted: Task "{name}" is already marked as completed.
en.SwitchSuccess: Switched tracking: stopped previous timer and started task "{name}" [ID: {taskId}].
en.StoppedAllSessions: Stopped all ({count}) active tracking sessions across all projects.
en.SandboxModeEnabled: [SANDBOX] In-memory learning emulator enabled. Changes will NOT be persisted to SQLite.
en.SandboxModeDisabled: [SANDBOX] Switched back to LIVE business engine. Changes are persisted to SQLite.
en.SandboxResetDone: [SANDBOX] In-memory demonstration data has been reset to defaults.

de.WelcomeHelp: Geben Sie "help" oder "oxyhelp" ein, um die Liste der verfügbaren Befehle zu öffnen.

de.ProjectsDesc: Listet alle Projekte in der SQLite-Datenbank auf
de.TasksDesc: Listet alle Aufgaben und Unteraufgaben eines Projekts auf

de.StatusDesc: Zeigt Details des aktiven laufenden Timers an

de.SandboxModeDisabled: [SANDBOX] Zurück zum LIVE-Modus gewechselt. Änderungen werden in SQLite gespeichert.

pt-br.WelcomeHelp: Digite "help" ou "oxyhelp" para abrir a lista de comandos disponíveis.
pt-br.WelcomeSqliteConnected: Conexão com SQLite estabelecida com sucesso.

pt-br.ProjectsDesc: Lista todos os projetos no banco de dados SQLite
pt-br.TasksDesc: Lista todas as tarefas e subtarefas de um projeto
pt-br.AddProjectDesc: Cria um novo projeto (nome entre aspas)

pt-br.CompleteDesc: Alterna o status de conclusão de uma tarefa

pt-br.SandboxDesc: Controla o emulador de aprendizado sandbox em memória (on/off/status/reset)
